_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Game Server Watcher egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Game Server Watcher
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Game Server Watcher keeps live status messages for your game servers in Discord, Telegram and Slack. Builds its latest code on first start and serves its setup page on the server's port.
startup: if [ -z "$SECRET" ]; then echo "Set the admin password in the server's startup settings, then start it again."; exit 1; fi; h=$(cat .git/HEAD package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat dist/.raptor-built 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing packages and building Game Server Watcher. This takes a few minutes."; npm ci --include=dev --no-fund --no-audit && npm run build && echo "$h" > dist/.raptor-built || exit 1; fi; export HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} DATA_PATH=./data/ NODE_ENV=production; exec node dist/server.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Game Server Watcher: clones it from its Git repository, or pulls the
# newest code into an existing copy. It has no releases, so this is always
# its latest code. It's built when the server starts. The data folder (the
# watched servers and the bots' messages) is kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=https://github.com/a-sync/game-server-watcher

git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server
[ -d .git ] || git init -q
git fetch -q --depth 1 "$repo" HEAD
# Only the app's own files are replaced; data/ holds nothing it tracks.
git -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q -f FETCH_HEAD
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Game Server Watcher at commit $(git rev-parse --short HEAD). It is built the first time it starts."

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for the setup page, at least 8 characters.

variables.name: Refresh minutes
variables.description: How often, in minutes, the servers are checked and the messages updated.

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: A Discord bot's token, to post status messages in Discord.

variables.name: Telegram bot token
variables.description: A Telegram bot's token, to post status messages in Telegram.

variables.name: Slack bot token
variables.description: A Slack bot token (xoxb-), to post status messages in Slack.

variables.name: Slack app token
variables.description: The Slack app-level token (xapp-) that goes with the Slack bot.

variables.name: Steam web API key
variables.description: A Steam web API key, for details of Steam games that need one.

variables.name: Debug logging
variables.description: Write detailed logs to the console.
